title: Why Being Poor Is So Expensive (Your $4 Coffee Costs $39)
alts: Overdraft Fees Explained: Why Being Broke Costs You Extra
Why Your Bank Charges You More When You're Broke
line1: Why does being poor cost more? Dave was $3 short, and a $35 overdraft fee turned his $4 coffee into a $39 coffee.
summary: Dave is three dollars short, and his bank turns a $4 coffee into a $39 one with a $35 overdraft fee. We follow the money to find out why being poor is so expensive: overdraft fees that the CFPB says work like a 17,000% APR loan, the Terry Pratchett 'boots theory', why low-income families pay more per roll of toilet paper, rent-to-own, payday loans at almost 400% APR, check cashing, the 5.6 million unbanked households, and why poor credit can double your car insurance. Then we bust the myth that poor people are just bad with money, and show practical ways to stop paying the poverty tax.
